process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running, including a bare `git rev-parse HEAD`, `gh pr view 240` and `git diff 86d33e6..HEAD --stat`. Each one died at sandbox startup with: `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. So the PR diff, its metadata, its threads and the head SHA were all out of reach. Reviewer subagents use the same Bash tool and could not have read the diff either, so no reviewer was spawned. Findings without the diff would be ungrounded, and their provenance could not be checked. PR #240 was NOT reviewed. This record is not a clean review. Re-run once the runner's sandbox allows user namespaces, or once bubblewrap gets CAP_SYS_ADMIN.

Nothing was reviewed. The gated roster this PR needed was never spawned: correctness, conventions, maintainability, docs and context, plus security if its gate held. Grep shows the change touches src/cli/index.ts, src/core/types/land.types.ts, docs/adr/0132-pup-land-no-audit-lets-several-lands-share-one.md, docs/adr/README.md and docs/adr/0084-pup-land-session-closes-the-github-half-of.md, but the full file list could not be confirmed. Treat this round as incomplete.
